title: Reversed motion graphics next to the original
caption: Six seconds of the motion promo, where the checklist card collapses into a pill and the pill morphs, played forward on the left and reversed with mgvideo reverse on the right: the same frames, so the rewind reads as the card building itself back up.
prompt: Reverse 6 seconds of ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 (from 4 s, the checklist card collapsing into the pill) for a rewind transition. Show it to the client side by side with the forward clip on a dark brown frame, each with a small Geist label (labels.svg, fonts/).
commands: ffmpeg -i work/forward.mp4 -i work/reversed.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "color=c=0x2b1c17:s=1920x1080:r=30:d=6[bg];[0:v]scale=912:513,setsar=1[l];[1:v]scale=912:513,setsar=1[r];[bg][l]overlay=32:300[a];[a][r]overlay=976:300[b];[b][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/compare.mp4
